🏡🚧 Buying a New Build? STOP & Ask These 5 Questions First! 🚧🏡

Before you sign on the dotted line, make sure you know exactly what you’re getting into! Here are 5️⃣ must-ask questions to protect your wallet 💰👇

1️⃣ What’s included?
That “starting price” might not cover the lot, upgrades, or even landscaping! 🌱💸 Always ask for a breakdown.

2️⃣ Who pays closing costs?
Some builders offer incentives, but it’s not guaranteed! 💲💬 Negotiate upfront.

3️⃣ Can I use my own realtor?
YES! 🙌 The builder has already factored in commission, so having a pro on your side costs you NOTHING—just be sure to mention your realtor on your first visit! 🏡🔑

4️⃣ How much is due at signing?
Deposits for the home, lot, & upgrades can add up FAST. ⚠️ Plus, some may be non-refundable! Always check.

5️⃣ Are there HOA fees or extra taxes?
Hidden costs like HOA fees & special assessments can make your monthly payments 📈—know before you commit!

✨ Buying new construction is exciting, but don’t go in blind! With the right questions (and the right realtor 😉), you can secure the best deal with confidence.
